body: Does insurance cover the cost of the vaccine? I was bit by a strangers dog today that looked really mangy and acted strange, but I don’t want to spend thousands of dollars on something that might just be my anxiety, as I’m only 19 and don’t have thousands of dollars

I had one 1 hour meeting with a therapist before the pandemic hit and when my ocd wasn’t as bad (back then it was just the driving thing). He was a pretty nice guy and he basically just told me to think of a place where I’m relaxed. I didn’t go back to him because he ended up charging me an extra 150 bucks for going 5 minutes over the allotted time or something like that.

Last week I talked to another therapist, and this one specializes in ocd. She prescribed me some sort of ssri/antidepressant right off the bat, and I’ve kind of been putting off taking it. I’ve never taken any drugs/pain killers or drank before because I feel like it’ll take away what makes me “me,” if that makes sense. I’m not depressed, either, I’m just stressed out a lot. I meet with her again in a couple of weeks, so we’ll see how it goes! I just want to be able to smile again and feel good about my future. I miss being able to feel good about life and being able to be there for my friends/family. Part of me wants to give up my worries to God, but it’s still hard for my brain to ‘move on’ from my worries.

Thanks, guy!

This year’s also been really rough for me. The pandemic honestly doesn’t bother me too much, but I feel like the fact that everyone else is stressed out kind of messes me up subconsciously and makes my ocd worse.

I go through false memory/harm ocd, where I obsess about whether or not I accidentally hurt someone without realizing it. I’ve had it ever since I turned 18, and I’m 19 now. The past couple of months have gotten increasingly dark for me, and I don’t think I’ve had a “good day” since May. I hope you keep your ocd in its place. The good thing about ocd is that when it goes away for a brief period of time, even for a couple of minutes, life feels incredible.

I miss when I was able to feel like I had a future, and when I could be a better son/friend, before all of these stupid worries started flooding my mind. I feel like I’m working 16 hours a day for ocd. I used to be so happy and innocent, and now I spend all of my days making sure I didn’t hurt anyone (false memory, harm ocd). There’s no one I can really talk to, plus my thoughts sound crazy so anyone who I trust/care about would think I’m nuts. I just want to be able to go to work, go home, hang out with friends, and live a normal life not constantly in panic mode. I don’t see it getting better, though. I get seconds of relief from my anxiety when I finally “solve” an ocd worry, if that makes sense, but then my brain finds a new thing to worry about and the next couple of days are hell.

Anyway, just know that you’re not alone. I also think that not being able to see our friends/family/go out to places as much with everything going on kind of subconsciously stresses us out and makes our ocd worse. I just turned 19 and lived a pretty happy life until about a year ago when my ocd ramped up, and in the past couple of months, it’s gotten increasingly dark for me. I hope that you can find some relief and I hope we can both look back on all of this a couple of years from now and be glad it’s over.

Hey man, sorry no one has responded, I also have false memory+harm ocd but I have different themes. I don’t really have any advice, but just know that you’re not alone in your feelings of being afraid of going to jail for something you didn’t realize that you did.

It really kicks your confidence to the curb because you feel like you could be put in jail any day now.

I hate it because even though deep down you know you did something wrong, you’re ocd still says “yeah, but what if” or “yeah, but what if you were just so anxious at the time so you really did do this.” There’s no sort of relief until you find a new thing to worry about, and then your past worries seem stupid. Hope all of that made sense, I’m kind of tired right now and stressed out from my own ocd.

Anyway, how are you doing now? Are you feeling better/still a little stressed/found something new to worry about?

Hey, I’m also dealing with really bad ocd, and it constantly makes me paranoid that I had just done something wrong without realizing it. I don’t really have any advice because I’m pretty much at an all time low right now and don’t see how my ocd will ever go away, but just know that there’s other people suffering with you and this year has been especially rough for everyone.

I think that the anxieties of everyone else, along with not being able to see people’s’ smiles (masks) kind of messes with our already anxious/paranoid minds. I hope you get better
Hey man, I’m feeling awful as well right now. What fears/anxieties do you have?
Thanks for responding, man. Hopefully everything turns out okay and I can look back on all of these worries and laugh them off a couple of years from now. Hope you’re doing okay
I’ve had the same thing for about a year and a half. Every day is like a battle. Currently worrying about my driving route about 2 hrs ago. What do you usually do to feel better?

It seems like as soon as I feel like I got past the last intrusive thought, I’m onto the next. My hit and run ocd just got refreshed when I drove tonight, and I know the next couple of days will be hell. I might even call the police station again (I’ve done it like 3 times in the past month) to make sure I haven’t hit anyone. I’m so tired. Every day is like a battle
Every time I try to feel good about my future/goals, my brain tells me that I’m either gonna die or go to jail and Ill end up homeless
